resources.string: Swipe down from the top edge of the bottom screen to open WalkThor, and swipe again to put it away. While a game is running, it also taps the very top edge of the game\'s screen once after WalkThor opens or after you search, which hands the game back Android\'s top performance priority. Optionally, only while the Face Buttons screen is open (after you agree), it sees your controller button presses to light up the matching buttons, passing every press straight on to the game. Optionally, only if you turn on Detect games from any emulator (for when you don\'t use Cocoon), it notes which app comes to the front and, for the running emulator only, its window title and notifications, to tell which game you\'re playing; nothing is kept after the game ends. Otherwise it doesn\'t read, store or change what\'s on your screen, and doesn\'t keep any presses.
